text:
maya: Kickoff — 'Tutorial Orbit' launch sequence. Plan: OSS tutorial + tiny refapp, 30-min webinar (demo + Q&A), benchmark narrative + launch post, and inbound lead routing. Goal: drive 1k dev signups and 200 webinar attendees. 

alex: Love it. Timeline?

maya: Target week of Apr 27 for publish, webinar May 8. Drafts ready by Apr 15 for review.

sam: Benchmarks: I can run 3 configs (cpu, small-gpu, quantized) and surface latency/cost delta. Need sample prompts from content.

erin: I can draft tutorial steps + copy for blog and tweet thread. Can we standardize examples to a simple refapp (chat + embeddings) so it's reproducible?

maya: Yes — keep refapp minimal: 2 endpoints, docker + one-click deploy on hosted. Make code snippets < 15 lines.

alex: For webinar — want a short live demo of the refapp and a bench slide comparing latency/throughput/cost. Also 1 slide on 'routing & fallbacks' (hosted -> dedicated).

jordan: Inbound routing: capture leads via a gated playbook download; nurture sequence: immediate email + 2-week drip with benchmark highlights. Who owns the form?

erin: I can wire the gated doc; jordan, can you own the email templates?

jordan: Yep. I'll set up the form and hubspot flow. Want a UTM scheme: campaign=tutorial-orbit, source=webinar|blog|tweet.

sam: Quick ask: give me the prompt set and target seq len so bench is realistic (longest sample ~512 tokens?).

maya: Use real-world prompts: customer-support convo, summarization of 800-token doc trimmed to 512, embeddings for short snippets.

alex: Messaging iteration: primary angle = 'ship production-grade inference with minimal ops'. Secondary = 'cost/perf benchmarks you can reproduce'. Keep headlines punchy.

erin: Draft headline options:
- "Build a reproducible LLM refapp in 20 minutes"
- "Open-source starter for production LLM inference"

maya: +1 second. Also make a short TL;DR for social: one sentence, one emoji.

devrel-bot: Checklist created: https://ok.redwood/launch-checklists/tutorial-orbit (assets, demo recording slot, slides, bench results, gated doc, form).

maya: Asset requests: demo video (alex), step-by-step tutorial (erin), repo + deploy button (alex), bench report (sam), marketing images (erin). Deadline Apr 15.

alex: I'll handle repo + deploy and record a 7-min demo clip. Posting on repo: include `README.md` with quickstart and expected metrics.

sam: Bench schedule: start runs Apr 8, publish csv + plot embedded in blog. I'll include cost per 1k tokens and latency p50/p95.

erin: I'll draft blog outline by Apr 10 and a tweet thread. Example tweet copy (short):
"Want reproducible, production-ready LLM demos? We built a tiny refapp + benchmark kit to get you started. Webinar May 8 — RSVP: https://redwood.ai/rsvp #LLMops"

maya: Can we do one more experiment: include a 'how to cost-optimize' sidebar using quantization & KV cache? Small checklist for engineers.

sam: Good idea. I'll add quantized numbers + guidance.

jordan: For leads: please add a checkbox on the form "Interested in Dedicated" to route to AE team. I'll create an automation.

erin: Need approvals on messaging and screenshots by Apr 18.

maya: Final owners: maya (launch owner), alex (refapp + demo), erin (content + social), sam (bench), jordan (lead routing).

alex: Quick placeholder for repo description: `Tiny refapp for fast LLM inference — demo, bench, and deploy in minutes.`

maya: Awesome. Next sync Thu Apr 11 10am PT. If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :thumbsup:

erin: I'll post the first draft blog outline in this thread by Apr 10.

sam: I'll ping with preliminary bench numbers Apr 9.

jordan: I'll share the form + hubspot flow draft Apr 12.

maya: Thanks all — aiming for an executable, low-friction launch that the community can fork. :rocket:
